title: Friday State
lede: A NEW YORKER on a token is a stack of finished states, and the stack grows. New states land on Fridays. This page is the schedule.
intent: Dates are the artist's published intent and can move. Nothing already on a token is ever removed.

appended.title: Already appended
appended.intro: What is on the tokens today. On THE CENSUS RELEASE the states live in each token's metadata and viewer: click the art to step through them. On KEYSTONE they are ERC-7160 states the holder pins.

states.name: MOSH
states.what: A MOSH LAB glitch still of the piece, the same seed every time, so each token's glitch is its own.

states.name: MOSH LOOP
states.what: The same glitch as a loop, 1280 wide, sitting between MOSH and DITHER in the stack.

states.name: DITHER
states.what: The piece as an ordered dither, dark and blue pieces in one ramp, the rest in another.

states.name: PIXEL
states.what: The 256 pixel portrait from the on chain pixel census, scaled up crisp, before DITHER in the stack.

states.name: ANIMATED
states.what: The piece really moves: a five second loop with the VHS inside, first frame equal to last, so it never stops.

states.name: VHS GLITCH
states.what: The first motion pass, the frozen glitch clips, kept as a state of their own.

states.name: PAINTED, MOTION, GLITCH, DITHER
states.what: Every Keystone carries its still, a motion state, its MOSH LAB glitch loop and two dithers: 660 states across the 111.

appended.note: States are pre rendered to token 1000 so a New Yorker minted today arrives with its stack. Tokens 1001 to 1111 carry the still alone until their batch is rendered.

pinning.title: How pinning works
lines: A Keystone is an ERC-7160 token on Transient Labs: one token, a stack of finished states, and the artist can append to the stack after you own it.
The holder pins the state that shows, from their own wallet on transient.xyz, and can move the pin any time; a state is never taken off the stack.
Census New Yorkers mint on OpenSea as ERC-721 tokens that are dynamic by metadata: the stack of states lives in each token and its own viewer, so the same Fridays reach them.
